svg.title: The LCW status bar in a terminal, followed through one run: You say what you want, in plain words. Brainstorm: Claude asks, probes and tracks what is settled. Spec: a blind reviewer explains it back before anything is built. Build: orchestrators and their workers, each with its model, tokens and time. It comes to you only when what you agreed cannot be built. At your usage mark it pauses, and carries on when the limit resets. Finished: a draft pull request is waiting for your review. A card above the prompt shows the run, its stage, its tasks and its agents; two rows under the prompt show a small mascot, a different creature in each scene with the face that scene calls for, and beside it the model, the context and the week's usage against the mark.
